lines.en: Welcome to our hall, Theo. The choir was founded in 1950.
lines.pt: Bem-vindo ao nosso salão, Theo. O coro foi fundado em 1950.

lines.en: Really? Who was it founded by?
It was founded by a teacher and ten students from the city.
lines.pt: Foi fundado por um professor e dez alunos da cidade.

lines.en: And when was this hall built? It looks very old.
lines.pt: E quando este salão foi construído? Parece muito velho.

lines.en: It was built in 1890, and it was repaired last year.
lines.pt: Foi construído em 1890 e foi reformado no ano passado.

lines.en: Was the stage changed too? The floor looks new.
lines.pt: O palco também foi mudado? O piso parece novo.

lines.en: Yes, it was made of wood, and the lights were replaced.
lines.pt: Sim, foi feito de madeira e as luzes foram trocadas.

lines.en: Were the old costumes made here in the hall?
lines.pt: As fantasias antigas foram feitas aqui no salão?

lines.en: No, they were bought in London, and they were washed by volunteers.
lines.pt: Não, foram compradas em Londres e foram lavadas por voluntários.

lines.en: Who was the conductor? I saw his photo near the door.
lines.pt: Quem era o maestro? Vi a foto dele perto da porta.

lines.en: He was hired in 2010, and the audience was always happy with him.
lines.pt: Ele foi contratado em 2010 e o público sempre ficou feliz com ele.

facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio, e by + agente se precisar: was founded, were replaced.

facts.label: foi/foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio para falar do passado sem dizer quem fez: The hall was built in 1890. The lights were replaced. Was é para uma coisa e were é para várias.

facts.label: por + pessoa
facts.sub: Use by + pessoa para dizer quem fez: It was founded by a teacher. They were washed by volunteers. Se o agente não importa, não precisa usar by.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “foi fundado em 1950” e “foi construído”.
compare.us: Em inglês, use was/were + particípio: was founded, were replaced. Use was com uma coisa e were com várias. Para dizer quem fez, use by: was founded by a teacher. Para perguntar: When was it built? Who was it written by?

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: The choir was founded in 1950.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was founded is a passive form.

items.why: We need was: The hall was built in 1890.

items.s: By + person tells who did the action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Was founded is a passive form. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The hall built in 1890.” → Falso (We need was: The hall was built in 1890.)
By + person tells who did the action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A choir in Cardiff · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy evening in Cardiff. Theo arrives at an old hall. Abby opens the big wooden doors. There is a rehearsal tonight. A song book with the anthem lies on the piano. Theo wants to know the story of the choir.
“Welcome to our hall, Theo. The choir was founded in 1950.” says Abby. “Really? Who was it founded by?” says Theo. “It was founded by a teacher and ten students from the city.” says Abby.
